note: Curated from the Btown Brief newsletter vault (editions Oct 23 - Nov 13, 2026). TALKING-POINTS.md is the style doctrine; refreshes land as PRs and points age out via 'added'.

points.text: Lake Champlain's own Champ is getting a turquoise cameo on a USPS forever stamp next year, one of five mythical creatures the Postal Service is honoring in 2027. Which other local legend deserves its own stamp?

A 28-foot mural celebrating the Old North End now covers a wall inside Integrated Arts Academy, built from the foods students told artist Jozie Furchgott Sourdiffe mattered to them, with some of their own artwork woven in. What dish would you want painted into a mural about your own neighborhood?

Vermont Pub & Brewery on College Street poured its last pints this weekend after 38 years, with the Burly Irish Ale — on tap the entire run — the first keg to sell out. What's your go-to order there, or the one you never got around to trying?

Hong Yu is retiring after 27 years selling her family's dumplings, first from a Church Street cart and then her Pearl Street shop, and she's hunting for a buyer willing to keep the business going before her lease runs out in May. Which dumpling order of hers would you put in one last time?

Seven Days points to this year's records from Greg Freeman, Robber Robber, Dari Bay and Lily Seabird as proof Burlington's DIY basement scene has built a sound the wider music world is noticing. Which of those bands would you want headlining your own house show?

Lyric Theatre Company's 'Elf the Musical' opened at the Flynn this week and launched Lyric For All, a program handing out free tickets through partners like Lund, King Street Center and Vermont Adult Learning for every big musical from here on. Which Lyric show would you want to bring someone to for their first time at the Flynn?

Toys for Kids kicked off its 31st year with about 150 barrels scattered around the region, and Vermont Rail System's Toys for Kids Train is back for its second year with roughly a dozen trips. Which stop would get your first unwrapped toy?

Seven Days toured five cafés that opened around Chittenden County this year, from Michael Chase's art-filled Artemus Café on Church Street to Clover Café's cold foam that took off on TikTok to Wild Meadows Books & Café pairing Mocha Joe's coffee with a full bookstore. Which one gets your next Saturday morning?

UVM's 13th Trotting of the Turkeys had students and volunteers hauling frozen birds from Patrick Gym to Virtue Field, raising more than $18,000 toward a $20,000 goal for Feeding Champlain Valley. Which job would you rather have: hauling turkeys across campus, or counting donations at the finish line?

UVM ASL instructor Brittney Lipson teamed up with Burlington Trolley Tours for an hour-long ride narrated live in sign language, hoping to show business owners that deaf people live and work all over the city. Which Burlington spot would you want to see get its own interpreter on staff?

Finn Hamilton spotted a city email address on his parents' water bill at 14, applied, and now at 16 sits on the Essex Junction City Planning Commission pushing for housing he hopes brings rents down by the time he's house-hunting himself. What would you have applied for at 14 if you'd known you could?

Rodney, Tracie and Jake Oliveira just took over the B.U. Pub, the Porters Point Road dive that's been a Colchester fixture since the 1970s, redoing the bathrooms and floors while keeping the original staff on. What's the one thing you'd never let them change about a dive bar like that?

Leo & Co. closes its doors in the Essex Experience this week, and Glazed Donuts is turning the space into a café with a doughnut sandwich, a secret weekend pizza menu and a kids' play area by December. Doughnut sandwich or secret pizza — which are you ordering first?

Charlie's Boathouse, the old boat rental and snack bar on the Burlington bike path, is becoming a public park after the family sold its 600 feet of shoreline to the Winooski Valley Park District. What would you want built there first — a dock, a picnic spot, or just a bench?

UVM's Perkins Museum of Geology has reopened after six years dark, with the Charlotte Whale — Vermont's official state fossil — back on display and student interns running the exhibits. What's the most surprising thing you'd guess is hiding in a geology museum?
Bluebird BBQ closed for good on Riverside Avenue after more than 17 years and a turn on "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives." What's the dish you'd drive across town for one last time?

Crews from two Massachusetts clock shops are rebuilding the hand-made mechanisms on the First Unitarian Universalist church tower at the top of Church Street, since you can't just buy the parts at a hardware store. What's the most important clock in your own daily life?

Amtrak says 131,000 people got on or off a train in Vermont last year, a 40% jump from before the pandemic, even though the ride to New York City still takes seven and a half hours. Worth it for the scenery, or do you stick to flying?

Vermont Tortilla is back in production at a new Essex facility after losing its Shelburne lease and a shot at Hinesburg over water limits, with owners Leyland Papa and Lindsey West now shipping frozen tortillas nationwide. What's the dish in your fridge that absolutely needs a good tortilla?

An 11-foot stainless steel sculpture called "Jambo" — Swahili for hello — is going up near the Dorset Street entrance of Veterans Memorial Park, a gift from South Burlington resident Todd Lockwood valued at $80,000. What's the first thing you'd want a giant sculpture to say to people walking into your neighborhood park?

Beta Technologies just became the first company authorized by the FAA to fly paying passengers on its electric aircraft, and its first ride under that approval went from Plattsburgh to Burlington in 20 minutes. Where's the first place you'd want to fly on one of those?

Chris Taylor is stepping down as Vermont Green FC's head coach after two years that included a 45-game unbeaten run, a Steinbrecher Cup and back-to-back USL2 national titles. What's the one game from that streak you'd replay if you could?
